adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts, line 97 shows `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then line 98-100 shows `await prisma.credential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { key },`. The parseRefreshTokenResponse function (shown in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) returns `refreshTokenResponse` which is the result of `safeParse()` - this returns an object with `{success, data, error}` structure, not the actual parsed data. The code should be using `refreshTokenResponse.data` instead of the whole SafeParseResult object. This would cause the credential to be stored incorrectly and fail on next use.
